Written responses
Your expertise and experience *
Please describe your experience and expertise in each subject you'd like to add, including the grade levels you've taught it at. This can
include academic degrees, professional experience, tutoring, volunteering, or relevant personal background - address each subject
directly and be as specific as possible, as the more detail you provide, the faster we can process your request. If you've indicated
teaching a language other than English, please respond primarily in English.
Session overview *
Walk us through what a session with you actually looks like, using a specific learner or class you've worked with (real or realistic). We'd
like to understand how you figure out what that learner needs, how you structure the time toward a clear goal, how you keep them
engaged and check they're really getting it, and what you do when they get stuck. Please note whether you're describing 1:1 tutoring or
a group class. Concrete examples tell us far more than a general teaching philosophy.
Business and marketing experience
As a marketplace for online learning, having an entrepreneurial mindset is valuable. Please share any experience that you have
marketing yourself, running a business, or building a client base. No experience? That's ok! You can also share how you might market
your Dojo Tutor offerings.
Dojo Tutor is a marketplace of live, online learning experiences. If your submission is approved, you'll be prompted to complete a
background check and receive our standard Independent Contractor contract. Please note that this is not an application for
employment and Dojo Tutor does not hire tutors for any roles.
